name: Bathua Paratha
steps: Pick and wash bathua leaves thoroughly. Blanch for 2 minutes, drain well, squeeze dry and finely chop.
Combine flour, bathua, minced chilli, cumin and salt. Add water gradually and knead into a smooth soft dough; rest covered for 15 minutes.
Divide into eight balls and roll each into a 17 cm circle, dusting lightly. Fold once and roll again if you prefer layers.
Cook on a medium-hot tawa until small bubbles appear. Flip, brush with a little ghee, flip again and cook until both sides are brown-spotted.
Serve hot with yogurt; cool completely before packing.
tips: Dry the blanched greens well so the parathas do not tear.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
